objective: Preserve each authenticated member's Android PTT preferences over screen/app restart and prevent saved-but-unapplied route/group/channel choices from appearing active; preserve explicit Stop and safe SOS behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source SHA ecd34228dd24f07a47ba397bb1c29199aac51779 was fetched and inspected 2026-11-21. Exact live Android binary, OTA group, runtime and audio device behavior were NOT independently verified. DEV branch only; do not promote without verified staging RC and mandatory ad/nav gates.
chosenApproach: Use per-account AsyncStorage persistence for preferred route, scope, channel, listening switch and normal/priority mode; hydrate before visual selection; distinguish preferred from live Stream call; serialize and commit target swaps only after server monitor confirmation; honor persisted stop in bootstrap and normal push; do not claim Nearby transport before implementation. SOS remains per-session emergency arming.
selectionRationale: UI had AUTO/CH01/preselected group before hydration, updated targets optimistically, and autoconnected after explicit Stop; stored route writes swallowed failures, while failed target joins could leave disconnected prior calls marked active. Account-scoped confirmed preferences plus runtime-backed live labels correct the sources of drift without altering Stream floor authorization.
alternativeApproaches: Store all preferences remotely in a new Supabase table/RPC and require backend migration; rejected for narrowly scoped device preferences, extra network dependence and release risk.
Persist only visual chip states without reconciling underlying connection state; rejected because it would perpetuate misleading activation and unsafe retry behavior.
Selected: confirmed per-account local preferences, transparent live state and safe serialized runtime switching.
acceptanceChecks: App/screen reopen restores the authenticated user's last saved route, CH01-CH10, scope, Stop/Start listening and NORMAL/PRIORITY; settings never leak across users.
Options do not appear as live before confirmed runtime connection; route and group/channel labels distinguish saved preference, live and unsaved applied state.
Failed disk write never falsely claims settings were saved; failed channel join preserves previous functioning connection and monitor.
Stop during pending join waits for completion and leaves no active channel; background normal push and bootstrap do not undo saved Stop.
Disabled/missing Internet shows offline, not fictional Nearby ready; direct-device Nearby is explicitly unavailable in this build.
SOS arming requires explicit current-session confirmation; no automatic SOS re-arm on reopen.
Existing Stream floor leases, push Priority/SOS, caption consent, ads, organization/cluster authorization and unrelated app navigation stay unchanged.
Focused Node tests and required scope gates pass; staging device audio and ad/nav tests must run before any OTA.
preserveBehaviors: Valid active membership remains required to join Stream organization/cluster channel CH01-CH10; server floor leasing remains authoritative.
Hold to talk requires continuously held input; release immediately stops local transmit.
Priority/SOS incoming alerts and their server authorization remain active even if normal listening is paused.
PTT banner and global live Stream host are preserved; other Connect and ordinary phone calls remain unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Correct Android PTT runtime state and persisted member choices without marking pending selections as live.
preservedBehaviors: PTT Stream membership/floor authorization, voice hold/release, Priority/SOS, caption recording consent and global host behavior are preserved.
